description: Rachel joins Monica's apartment after abandoning her wedding, entering the tightly connected lives of Monica, Ross, Chandler, Joey and Phoebe as careers, first romances and Ross's long-standing feelings for Rachel begin reshaping the group.

s01e01.description: Rachel leaves her wedding and moves in with Monica, while Ross begins wondering whether his old crush on her might finally have a chance.

s01e02.description: Ross learns Carol is pregnant and must navigate impending fatherhood with Susan, while Rachel returns Barry's engagement ring.

s01e03.description: Phoebe's discovery of a thumb in a soda leads to an unexpected payout, while Monica worries that everyone likes her new boyfriend too much.

s01e04.description: Joey and Chandler take Ross to a hockey game while Monica, Rachel and Phoebe spend the evening spying on George Stephanopoulos.

s01e05.description: Ross and Rachel tackle laundry together, while Joey recruits Monica to help him win back a former girlfriend.

s01e06.description: Joey lands a small film role and Chandler dates a woman whose complicated marriage history quickly overwhelms him.

s01e07.description: A citywide blackout traps Chandler with Jill Goodacre while Ross's attempt to tell Rachel how he feels is derailed by a stray cat.

s01e08.description: Ross and Monica mourn their grandmother, while an awkward hospital mix-up gives the family one last shock.

s01e09.description: Thanksgiving plans collapse when the friends get locked out of Monica's apartment, leaving everyone to improvise a holiday together.

s01e10.description: Ross adopts Marcel the monkey as New Year's approaches, while Phoebe begins a romance with scientist David.

s01e11.description: Chandler's flamboyant novelist mother visits New York, kisses Ross and exposes old tensions between Chandler and his parents.

s01e12.description: Rachel learns Paolo has betrayed her, while Ross and Carol await results from an amniocentesis.

s01e13.description: Chandler accidentally sees Rachel naked, Joey learns his father is having an affair, and Phoebe dates a psychiatrist who analyzes everyone.

s01e14.description: Valentine's Day brings Chandler back together with Janice, Ross into a strange date and the women into a ceremonial burning of old keepsakes.

s01e15.description: Monica tries to impress a restaurateur while Chandler faces a career decision and Ross struggles through an awkward date.

s01e16-17.description: Joey begins dating Phoebe's twin Ursula, creating trouble with Phoebe while Ross attends Lamaze classes and Chandler faces firing an attractive coworker. Phoebe confronts Ursula about Joey, Ross seeks parenting advice and Monica and Rachel pursue two doctors they meet at the hospital.

s01e18.description: The women join the men's poker night and Rachel's growing skill turns the game competitive just as she waits to hear about a job.

s01e19.description: Marcel escapes while Rachel is watching him, forcing the group into a frantic search before animal control finds the monkey first.

s01e20.description: Rachel resumes seeing Barry while Chandler agonizes over dating etiquette and the consequences of not calling after a date.

s01e21.description: Monica tracks down the woman using her credit card and becomes fascinated by her freer life, while Ross prepares to give Marcel away.

s01e22.description: Monica discovers her new boyfriend is much younger than she thought, while Phoebe's temporary job gives her an uncomfortable view of Chandler's office life.

s01e23.description: Carol goes into labor, forcing Ross and Susan to cooperate while Joey unexpectedly becomes involved with another expectant mother at the hospital.

s01e24.description: Rachel finally learns that Ross loves her, but the revelation comes just after he leaves for China.
